title: Alphabet
source: Science of Reading Level 1 Teacher Guide

units.title: Set 1: a, b, t, s, m
units.summary: Letters a, b, t, s, m (lessons 1 to 5). Teach what the letter looks like, what the mouth does, a motion and familiar words; the key words for a are apple, alligator and ax. Word parts: am, at, ab. Words to map and decode: am, at, ab, tab, Sam, mat, sat, bat.

lessons.title: Lesson 1: /ă/ = Aa
lessons.notes: Key words apple, alligator, ax. Mouth wide open; a motion with cupped hands. Sound, letter recognition (spot the letter), initial sound sort and letter formation.

lessons.notes: Sound, letter recognition (spot the letter), initial sound sort and letter formation.

lessons.notes: Sound, letter recognition (spot the letter), initial sound sort and letter formation.

lessons.notes: Sound, letter recognition (spot the letter), initial sound sort and letter formation.

lessons.notes: Letter hunts, games and workbook pages (workbook sold separately).

lessons.title: Words to map and decode
lessons.notes: am, at, ab, tab, Sam, mat, sat, bat

objectives.text: say the sounds for a, b, t, s and m when shown each letter
sort pictures by their first sound: /ă/, /b/, /t/, /s/ or /m/
write a, b, t, s and m with the correct letter strokes
blend sounds to read words like am, at, mat and sat

units.title: Set 6: e, w, y, x, q
units.summary: Letters e (/ĕ/), w, y, x (/ks/ at the end of words) and q (/kw/, always with u) (lessons 22 to 26). Word parts: eb, et, em, ep, en, ed, eg, ox, ix. Words to map and decode include web, bet, set, net, pet, ten, men, hen, bed, red, leg, peg, quit, yes, yet, box, fox, fix and mix. After the six sets: next steps and the alphabet assessment.
